prompt.alinti: FileSync lets you share large files peer-to-peer with no size limit and no accounts needed.
It's private by design. Files travel directly between browsers, so the server never sees your data.
You can send to many devices at once, and recipients don't need to install anything. They just open a link.
To use it, run one Docker command and share your room URL, then drop in files and they appear on everyone's device instantly.
Send files from one device to many in real time, no size limit — FileSync is a free, self-hosted alternative to WeTransfer.
Share room link to devices you want to share files with.
Comment file, and I'll send you the repo link.
